name: My Game
creator: @alesch
instruction: Tap to do the one thing this game is about.

creation.intent: Deliver a portrait session focused on this objective: Reach 10 points.
creation.playerFantasy: Master the challenge of My Game through repeated play.
creation.coreLoop: Tap to increase the score, finish the short run and try to improve.
creation.whyFun: Readable decisions and immediate feedback reward practice and a better next attempt.
creation.progression: Work toward the session objective, then improve the next result: Reach 10 points.
constraints: Portrait touch controls and the pinned platform runtime.
Use the platform lifecycle, storage and score APIs only.
weakSpots: Casual client-reported scores are not proof of verified play.

scoring.rationale: Higher session scores reward progress toward the stated objective.
scoring.measurement: The submitted scalar is the game’s final session score in points.
scoring.fairness: Shared ranks use earliest best submission; scores are casual and client-reported.

preserves: Retain platform lifecycle and touch accessibility.
changes: Child creators must describe their gameplay or presentation changes.
open: Tune difficulty, presentation and session objectives.
